---
title: "07 · What's the pattern across the top genes?"
output: html_notebook
---

> **Question:** the volcano showed *which* genes changed — a heatmap shows their
> *pattern* across every sample.

## Setup — run this first

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
data_dir <- if (dir.exists("data")) "data" else if (dir.exists("../data")) "../data" else "project/data"
counts <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "gene_counts.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
meta   <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
de     <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "DE_biofilm_vs_planktonic_24h.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Build the matrix (top genes, z-scored per gene)

```{r}
top_genes <- de %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FoldChange), n = 25) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

mat <- counts %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% top_genes) %>%
  select(-gene_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

z <- t(scale(t(log2(mat + 1))))      # z-score each gene

heat <- as.data.frame(z) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "sample", values_to = "z") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    sample  = factor(sample,  levels = meta %>% arrange(lifestyle, timepoint) %>% pull(sample)),
    gene_id = factor(gene_id, levels = de %>% filter(gene_id %in% top_genes) %>%
                                        arrange(log2FoldChange) %>% pull(gene_id))
  )
```

## The heatmap

```{r, fig.height=6}
ggplot(heat, aes(x = sample, y = gene_id, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "z-score") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7))
```
